decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans:
Elevation drawings; 25/1017/1; 25/1017/2; 39201-S3 Rev P1; 39202-S3 Rev P1; C2C - XX - XX- M2 - S 003  REV P01; C2C - XX - XX- M2 - S 004  REV P01; C2C - XX - XX- M2 - S 005  REV P01.
Reason:-
For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

Within three months of the date of the approval of this development, an Air Quality Neutral Assessment shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority.  The assessment must comply with London Air Quality Neutral guidance and updated
guidance, at the time the report is submitted. The assessment shall detail;
Calculations of the predicted building emissions and comparison against the Building Emission Benchmarks;
Calculations of the predicted transport emissions and comparison against the Transport Emission Benchmarks;
Mitigation (if required) or contribution to off-setting the development's emissions, taking into account the most up to date
Defra's damage costs and relevant guidance on offsetting payments.

The use hereby permitted shall not commence until all measures identified in the Air Quality Neutral Assessment have been shown to be implemented to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority in writing.

The drainage infrastructure, including the blind sump and bund channels, shall be maintained at all times to prevent the discharge of contaminated trade effluent into the surface water system.

To prevent the permanent and cumulative pollution of the water environment and to ensure the site is drained in a safe and sustainable manner, in accordance with Policy SI 5 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy 34 of the Havering Local Plan.
The equipment shall be maintained and operated in accordance with the mitigation measures and levels specified in the Noise Impact Assessment (Spectrum Acoustic Consultants Ref: BSB63/25287/R0).
Reason: To protect the amenity of the occupiers of neighbouring properties and to comply with Policy 34 of the Havering Local Plan and Policy D14 of the London Plan.
Positive and Proactive Statement

The Local Planning Authority has acted positively and proactively in determining this application by assessing the proposal against all material planning considerations, including planning policies and any representations which were received. It subsequently determined to grant planning permission in accordance with the National Planning Policy requirement that applications for sustainable development are approved where possible. A detailed analysis of the scheme is set out in the report on the application prepared by officers.

The applicant is advised that this planning permission does not override the requirement to maintain a valid Environmental Permit from the Environment Agency. The operation of the site must comply with all conditions of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016 to ensure industrial emissions and trade effluents are managed according to national standards.

Statement Required by Article 35(2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management) Order 2015: No significant problems were identified during the consideration of the application, and therefore it has been determined in accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
description: Application seeking retrospective planning permission for the installation of flues; the siting of an external compactor machine; the siting of an external Gas Farm; the siting of an external chiller machine; internal and external groundworks to accommodate the creation of a bund channel, the siting of a commercial washline machine, the installation of a bin washing machine, the siting of an Auto Clave Machine and associated scissor lift and blind sump, and to serve existing claves; the installation of an Air Conditioning Unit; and associated works

phasing_details.phase_detail: Entire Development - as a retrospective application, this work had already been completed by April 2024.
